claims.quote: When I say I want good growth in every postcode, that means every single postcode in Scotland as well.
claims.statement: The Prime Minister wants good growth in every postcode in Scotland.

claims.statement: Around one in twenty shops in Edinburgh are empty, against around one in five in Dundee.

claims.statement: The UK government is putting a billion pounds into research and innovation across the UK in the coming years.

claims.quote: It’s also why I am working on a new deal for food and farming at the EU-UK Summit on the 20th of November.
